`solve_model` passes the current `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` only converts a MultiIndex to flat form when the model is detected as flat. If a model is built with ordinary snapshots and the network is subsequently given MultiIndex snapshots, the helper passes that MultiIndex unchanged to `extra_functionality`, despite the model having been built with an ordinary index. Thus the guarantee does not hold for every network and call path.
